summary: frontend-orb 4.4.17 preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and executes math_init.js — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated single-line JavaScript file shipped in the tarball — using the fetched Bun binary at npm install time. math_init.js uses string-array indirection with a rotating shift routine and hex-mangled identifiers ('// @bun @bun-cjs' header, `n7gIxM=[...]` constant array, `WV8StW` shift function); setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifier mangling. The manifest declares `main: 'index.js'` but no index.js is present in the tarball, so the package has no library surface — its only install-time effect is the dropper. Pulling a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque sibling script is an alternate-runtime execution pattern that evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and is inconsistent with the package's presented CircleCI-orb aggregator purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
